text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm having a meal with Special Week, but 
she seems down in the dumps for some 
reason.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... Lately, it feels like all I 
do is sigh... *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I love racing, but... it's just not 
thrilling, I guess..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Even food doesn't taste good anymore... 
What in the world is happening to me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of her future success, it 
seems we'll need to review her race 
schedule...
